source: dharma.org teacher sitemap (137 teacher pages), Forest Refuge Schedule 2026 and 2027 pages, IMS Online Learning Center (ims.dharma.org, Thinkific: collections and course pages), read 1 Nov 2026. The Retreat Center residential schedule (myims.dharma.org) is embedded from events.dharma.org, whose robots.txt disallows all but search engines, so it was not read; Retreat Center retreats appear here only where IMS Online sells a livestream or hybrid version of them.
how_ranked: Current faculty = teaches an IMS programme starting after 4 Nov 2026 (Forest Refuge teaching month, IMS Online course, or a livestream or hybrid Retreat Center retreat), dates from the schedule and course pages. Ranked by claim likelihood: published email (then contact form, then website only, then no website on the IMS pages), in-person words on their site, then number of upcoming IMS programmes (lead scan of the website named on their IMS page or course page, 1 Nov 2026). Followers are read during research.

excluded.amod-sandhya-lele: academic speaker: a scholar of Buddhist philosophy appearing once as a book-club guest author (leadership, business or academic speaker)
excluded.dalila-bothwell: condition-led (health rule): her only upcoming IMS programme is framed around addiction recovery (Beyond Letting Go: The Four Right Efforts in Recovery)

not_checked_retreat_center_roster: The other names on dharma.org teacher pages (Retreat Center teachers, assistant teachers, movement instructors) could be current at the Retreat Center, but its dated schedule sits on events.dharma.org (robots.txt disallows), so they are not ranked here.
